name: Motion Designer
tagline: Makes a short motion film from code and checks it like an engineer: real brand facts, frame-by-frame contact sheets, measured colour and sound.
delivers: The film: a 1080p H.264 MP4 with mastered sound, and a poster frame
Contact sheets from every review round
CHECKS.md with every measurement and its result: brand colour, contact, loop seams, audio sync and the shipped file
The full source and a guide to re-rendering and changing copy, colours, timing and music
tools: GSAP or Remotion for UI motion
Tone.js or SciPy for sound, Pedalboard and pyloudnorm for mastering
OpenCV and Pillow for checks and contact sheets

brief.label: What is the film for, and the facts: exact copy, logos, brand colours as hex
brief.example: A launch clip for our note app: the line "Notes that write themselves", logo.svg in ./ref, brand #1F6FEB

brief.label: References: films or styles to learn from
brief.example: The pacing of Apple's product reveals, soft studio light, one slow camera move

brief.label: Length, aspect and music
brief.example: 20 seconds, 9:16 for social, upbeat electronic, hits on every cut

limits: Short films up to about 60 seconds made in code. No live footage or real people.
